t: Smart camera with 1080p full HD live view provides 360° horizontal and 130° vertical range to cover every corner. Features night vision, providing a clear visual distance up to 98ft even in total darkness, person detection and motion tracking. Allows customised audio to be recorded for use as a sound alarm. IP65 rating offers excellent waterproof and dustproof performance for outdoor use. Offers flexible storage choices, saving recorded videos to a microSD card up to 256GB (not supplied) or onto Tapo Care cloud storage service. Can be installed on any wall, ceiling or pole using the mounting screws, template and loops.
b: Works with - Amazon Alexa - Google Home - iOS App - Android App
